dont_panic: Your 2001 Ford WINDSTAR is showing code P0171. This means the engine is running too lean (not enough fuel) on Bank 1, which could be due to a faulty sensor, fuel delivery issue, or air intake leak. The vehicle’s own readings (like coolant temperature, fuel trims, or engine load) were not available, so the exact cause cannot be narrowed down. The code definition is standardized but not yet verified against official standards. This is not an immediate safety risk but needs further checks to confirm.
